1.consolidated_definition: Hierba de hasta 30 cm de altura, de ramas delgadas, hojas aovadas y dentadas de color verde oscuro y flores blancas cuyo fruto es globoso y amarillo. Scrophulariaceae, Scoparia dulcis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Plant with a height of up to 30 cm, featuring slender branches, ovate and toothed leaves with dark green coloration, and white flowers whose globular fruit is yellow. Scrophulariaceae, Scoparia dulcis.
